proposal.reason: Main change is in P2P IPC registration/import in transport to support multi-segment physical allocations (full-range mapping, segment-aware registration/deregistration, and MULTI_SEGMENT_REGISTER control). Network is also required because proxy RPC/FD exchange and proxy-side handle queue lifecycle were substantively extended for batch segment FD handling and teardown. Memory is required because allocation/free and deregistration ownership semantics were changed to unmap/free multiple segments safely and to poll callbacks before deregistration to avoid stale mapping reuse.
